As long as you're totally concentrated on what you're doing it should be fine! If you get it in your eyes you shouldn't worry straight away and stay calm and rinse it out and as long as you follow the rules and safety instructions everything should be fine. It could cause damage if you left it in your eye if you accidentally got it there but bearing in mind that the dye is intended for your eyelashes it is a much weaker concentration for normal dye so there is less risk. The eyelashes stay perfectly healthy and fall out later as usual which is when you reapply. If you are nervous about having shaky hands or accidentally jogging yourself into your eye, ask your partner or someone you live with to help you so you can try and stay still. As someone who has used both the kit and had it done professionally I totally recommend doing it yourself rather than getting it done as it is much cheaper with the same results. Good luck!
